##### Project general facts

Elevate by Prescott is a contemporary 16-storey residential development, offering a refined collection of studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. The architecture reflects a modern and elegant design approach, created by award-winning designers with a strong focus on aesthetics, functionality, and comfort. The building’s clean lines and well-balanced structure create a sophisticated presence, while thoughtfully designed layouts ensure spacious, light-filled interiors that enhance everyday living.

The development offers a lifestyle centred around relaxation, leisure, and community living, supported by a wide range of premium amenities. Residents can enjoy dedicated social spaces, landscaped gardens, and green parks that create a calm and refreshing environment away from the city’s pace. The project is designed to provide a balanced experience, combining wellness, recreation, and entertainment within a secure and well-planned residential setting that caters to both individuals and families.

Inside, Elevate by Prescott features meticulously crafted interiors with unmatched attention to detail, combining timeless elegance with modern design elements and luxurious finishes. Kitchens are equipped with state-of-the-art fixtures and fittings, offering a perfect blend of style, functionality, and comfort. The residences are fully furnished with elegantly designed interiors and high-quality furniture, ensuring a ready-to-move-in experience. Additional convenience is provided through dedicated electric and accessible parking spaces, enhancing everyday practicality for residents.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
